name: OpenStock
description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
one_liner: A free, self-hostable website for tracking stock prices, setting price alerts, and browsing company info, like a do-it-yourself version of a paid market data terminal.
buyer: A finance content creator or small investment newsletter who wants a branded market-data dashboard for their audience without paying for commercial market-data licenses.
business_use_cases: An investing newsletter or YouTuber self-hosts and re-brands it as a free companion tool that drives signups to their paid newsletter.
A local investment club runs it internally to track a shared watchlist instead of paying for a commercial terminal.
A developer forks it, adds premium alerting and portfolio analytics, and sells subscriptions to retail investors.

money_ideas.idea: Fork it, add premium alerting and analytics features, and sell subscriptions to retail investors.
White-label it for finance content creators as a branded watchlist tool that funnels to their paid product.

steal_this: Deploy a re-branded instance for a finance YouTuber's audience this weekend as free lead-gen for their paid newsletter.
